# Functions 

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(rlang)
library(rstatix)
library(purrr)

get_signif_per_group <- function(df, y_var, x_var = Treatment, group_var = organ) {
  yq <- enquo(y_var)
  xq <- enquo(x_var)
  gq <- enquo(group_var)
  
  y_name <- as_string(quo_get_expr(yq))
  x_name <- as_string(quo_get_expr(xq))
  g_name <- as_string(quo_get_expr(gq))
  
  se_fun <- function(v) sd(v, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(v)))
  
  df %>%
    group_by(!!gq) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      # if x has <2 groups → empty tibble
      if (n_distinct(.x[[x_name]]) < 2) return(tibble())
      
      # ANOVA
      frm <- as.formula(paste0(y_name, " ~ ", x_name))
      aov_res <- tryCatch(.x %>% anova_test(formula = frm), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(aov_res)) return(tibble())
      
      pval <- round(aov_res$p[1], 2)
      if (is.na(pval) || pval > 0.05) return(tibble())
      
      # tukey
      tukey_res <- tryCatch(.x %>% tukey_hsd(formula = frm), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(tukey_res) || nrow(tukey_res) == 0) return(tibble())
      
      tukey_res <- tukey_res %>%
        mutate(
          p.adj = round(p.adj, 2),
          label = case_when(
            p.adj <= 0.001 ~ "***",
            p.adj <= 0.01  ~ "**",
            p.adj <= 0.06  ~ "*",
            TRUE ~ "ns"
          )
        ) %>%
        filter(label != "ns")
      
      if (nrow(tukey_res) == 0) return(tibble())
      
      # vertical positions
      y_max <- .x %>%
        group_by_at(x_name) %>%
        summarise(m = mean(.data[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE) +
                    1.5 * se_fun(.data[[y_name]]),
                  .groups = "drop") %>%
        pull(m) %>%
        max(na.rm = TRUE)
      
      step <- 2 * se_fun(.x[[y_name]])
      group_value <- unique(.x[[g_name]])[1]
      
      tukey_res %>%
        mutate(
          y.position = y_max + (row_number() - 1) * step,
          group = as.character(group_value)
        )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
}

```

```{r 5}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(readr)

output_directory <- here("results/Graphs")
dir.create(output_directory, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)



cpg_data<- read.csv(here("data/Metrics_all_models/final_merged/results_cpg_final.csv"))

metrics_data <- read.csv(here("data/Metrics_all_models/final_merged/results_metrics_final.csv"))

predicted_data <- read.csv(here("data/Metrics_all_models/final_merged/results_predicted_final.csv"))

## -------- Define fuctions ---------- ##
clean_up_data <- function(df) {
  df %>% 
    filter(dataset == "Validation") %>%
    filter(!model %in% c("old_elastic_net", "old_lasso")) %>%  # remove old models  in case sill present 
    dplyr::mutate(
      rsq_threshold = dplyr::recode(
        rsq_threshold,
        "nofilter" = "r2_nofilter",
        "0.05" = "r2_0.05",
        "0.1"  = "r2_0.1",
        "0.2"  = "r2_0.2",
        "0.3"  = "r2_0.3"
      ),
      rsq_threshold = factor(
        rsq_threshold,
        levels = c("r2_nofilter","r2_0.05","r2_0.1","r2_0.2","r2_0.3")
      ),
      filter = factor(
        filter,
        levels = c("nofilter","min5", "min10", "min20")
      ),
      unique_model_id = paste(cpg_grouping,model_id, sep = "_")
    )  %>%
  mutate(
    organ = case_when(
      organ == "Fin_clip_caudal"~"Caudal_Fin" ,
      organ == "All_organs"~"Multi_organ"  ,
     TRUE ~ organ
    )
  )


}

get_shapes <- function(n) {
  # valid ggplot shapes: 0–25 
  # choose a clean subset
  shapes <- c(0:14)   # 15 visually distinct shapes
  
  if (n > length(shapes)) {
    stop("Need more shapes than available")
  }
  
  shapes[1:n]
}



## ------------- Clean up data 

cpg_data_validation       <- clean_up_data(cpg_data)
metrics_data_validation   <- clean_up_data(metrics_data)
predicted_data_validation <- clean_up_data(predicted_data)


## -- clean up probe column 
cpg_data_validation_long<- cpg_data_validation %>%
    tidyr::separate_rows(selected_cpgs, sep = ";") %>% # split cpg list 
  dplyr::mutate(selected_cpgs = trimws(selected_cpgs)) %>% # Ensure no whitespace issues
    mutate(selected_cpgs = gsub("chr","",selected_cpgs))%>%
  separate(selected_cpgs, c("chr","start","end"), remove = F, sep = ":")  %>%# split probe id to get chromosome metadtaa 
  dplyr::mutate(chr = trimws(chr),
                chr = factor(chr, levels = c(1:25)))
```
